title: ZIA source IP groups: IPv4/IPv6 split, predefined groups, entry formats

prose.label: Size.
prose.text: {{group-count}} The per-group entry cap is open {{gap:per-group-cap}}. Other caps are in [[zia.firewall.limits]].

purpose.statement: A source IP group is a single reusable object for enforcing rules across security policies such as Firewall, DLP, URL Filtering and SSL/TLS Inspection, and a change to a group's addresses applies to all linked security controls.

quotes: Source IP groups are used as a single, reusable object to enforce rules across various security policies.
You can apply source IP groups to policies, such as Firewall, DLP, URL Filtering, and SSL/TLS Inspection.
Automate policy updates by modifying IP addresses within a group once to automatically apply those changes across all linked security controls, minimizing configuration errors.

inbound-outbound.statement: Source IP groups let consistent inbound and outbound security rules be applied from unified source IP groups.

quotes: Enforce granular traffic control by applying consistent inbound and outbound security rules based on unified source IP groups.

ip-families.statement: Source IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are managed in separate groups. Two predefined groups, All IPv4 and All IPv6, contain all addresses of their type; custom groups can be created for IPv4 only, and custom IPv6 groups are not currently supported, so only the predefined All IPv6 group is available.

quotes: Source IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are managed in separate groups.
The Zscaler service provides two predefined groups (All IPv4 and All IPv6) that contain all addresses of their respective types.
Additionally, you can create custom groups for IPv4 addresses using individual IP addresses, subnets, or ranges to define specific network segments.
Custom groups for IPv6 addresses are not currently supported.
Currently, only the predefined All IPv6 group is available.

predefined-read-only.statement: The Source IPv4 Groups page lets an admin view details for read-only predefined groups.

quotes: View details for read-only predefined groups.
evidence.after: On the Source IPv4 Groups page (Internet Access > Resources > IP & FQDN Groups > Source IPv4 Groups), you can do the following:

entry-formats.statement: A custom source IPv4 group is created from individual, subnet or range IP addresses: an address (for example 198.51.100.100), a range (for example 192.0.2.1 - 192.0.2.10) or an address with a netmask (for example 203.0.113.0/24).

quotes: You can create custom source IPv4 groups by including individual, subnet, or range of IP addresses.

name-description.statement: A source IPv4 group name may contain only alphanumeric characters, underscores, hyphens and periods, and its description cannot exceed 10,240 characters.

quotes: Name: Enter a name for the source IPv4 address group. Only alphanumeric characters, underscores, hyphens, and periods are allowed.

group-count.statement: The limits table gives 4,000 source IP address groups.

per-group-cap.title: Entry cap for one source IP group
per-group-cap.detail: The About and Configuring pages give no per-group entry cap. The limits table's 8,000-entry row is the generic FQDNs or IP Address Entries per Group row, which the captured pages do not tie to source groups.
